title: 第四課
zh1:
老闆：請問你要買什麼？
明華：一杯熱咖啡。兩個包子。
老闆：你要大杯、中杯還是小杯？
明華：大杯。包子請幫我微波。
老闆：好的。請問外帶還是內用？
明華：外帶，一共多少錢？
老闆：咖啡八十，包子四十，一共一百二十塊。
py1:
Lǎobǎn：Qǐngwèn nǐ yào mǎi shénme?
Mínghuá：Yì bēi rè kāfēi. Liǎng ge bāozi.
Lǎobǎn：Nǐ yào dà bēi, zhōng bēi háishì xiǎo bēi?
Mínghuá：Dà bēi. Bāozi qǐng bāng wǒ wēibō.
Lǎobǎn：Hǎode. Qǐngwèn wàidài háishì nèiyòng?
Mínghuá：Wàidài, yígòng duōshǎo qián?
Lǎobǎn：Kāfēi bāshí, bāozi sìshí, yígòng yìbǎi èrshí kuài.
en1:
Store owner：Excuse me, what would you like to order?
Minghua：A cup of hot coffee and two baozi.
Store owner：Would you like a large, medium, or small cup?
Minghua：Large. Please microwave the baozi for me.
Store owner：OK. Is this to go or for here?
Minghua：To go. How much does that cost altogether?
Store owner：80 for the coffee, 40 for the baozi. That will be 120 in total.
zh2:
月美：我想買一支新手機。
明華：妳的手機很好。為什麼要買新的？
月美：我這支手機太舊了，不好看。
明華：妳想買哪種手機？
月美：能照相也能上網。
明華：那種手機很好，我哥哥有一支。
月美：貴不貴？一支賣多少錢？
明華：那種手機不便宜。一支要一萬五千多。
py2:
Yuèměi：Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì zhī xīn shǒujī.
Mínghuá：Nǐ de shǒujī hěn hǎo. Wèishénme yào mǎi xīn de?
Yuèměi：Wǒ zhè zhī shǒujī tài jiù le, bù hǎokàn.
Mínghuá：Nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ zhǒng shǒujī?
Yuèměi：Néng zhàoxiàng yě néng shàngwǎng.
Mínghuá：Nà zhǒng shǒujī hěn hǎo, wǒ gēge yǒu yì zhī.
Yuèměi：Guì bú guì? Yì zhī mài duōshǎo qián?
Mínghuá：Nà zhǒng shǒujī bù piányí. Yì zhī yào yíwàn wǔqiān duō.
en2:
Yuemei：I want to buy a new cell phone.
Minghua：Your cell phone is fine. Why do you want to buy a new one?
Yuemei：This one of mine is too old. It is unattractive.
Minghua：What kind of cell phone do you want to buy?
Yuemei：One that can take pictures and go online.
Minghua：Those kinds of cell phones are good. My brother has one.
Yuemei：Are they expensive? How much does one cost?
Minghua：That kind of cell phone is not cheap. One costs over NT$15,000.

act:
I. Ask and Talk about Prices
【目標 Goal】Learning to ask and answer the prices of items.
【做法 Task】A classmate bought items and knows the prices. Ask about the prices shown in the textbook.
【例】請問這個多少錢？
一共多少錢？

II. My Cell Phone
【目標 Goal】Learning to describe the size and functions of a cell phone with simple sentences.
【做法 Task】Introduce your own phone, explaining what it can do and its size.
【例】我的手機能……，也能……。它很大／很小。

III. Ask for Reasons
【目標 Goal】Learning to ask why someone buys a particular item.
【做法 Task】In pairs, discuss which phone is best as a gift, state your choice, and explain why.
【例】這三支手機，你喜歡……、……，還是……？為什麼？
……太……了。
一支要……。

IV. Counting from 11 to 110
【目標 Goal】Practise reading numbers from 11 to 110.
【做法 Task】Read the numbers aloud in sequence.
【例】十一 shíyī、二十一 èrshíyī、三十一 sānshíyī、四十一 sìshíyī、五十一 wǔshíyī、六十一 liùshíyī、七十一 qīshíyī、八十一 bāshíyī、九十一 jiǔshíyī；一百 yìbǎi、一百零一 yìbǎi líng yī、一百零二 yìbǎi líng èr、一百一十 yìbǎi yīshí。
cult:
24小時無休的便利商店 Around-the-clock Convenience Stores
剛來到臺灣的留學生，即使一句中文都不會說，也能在任何一家24小時營業的便利商店輕鬆買到一餐。許多外籍生回國後，仍十分懷念臺灣便利商店的方便。

臺灣的便利商店與在地生活密不可分，除了熱食便當、零食、飲料、文具、生活用品、DVD及雜誌，也提供影印、傳真、ATM提款、代收帳單、寄送快遞與郵件等服務。

網路訂購的商品、書籍、演唱會票或高鐵車票也能在便利商店取貨。端午、中秋或母親節等節慶期間，還可預購節慶大餐或蛋糕並於指定時間取貨，是人們日常生活中的全能幫手。

gps.title: I. Measures 塊、杯、支 and 種

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Measure Words

blocks.label: Structures 1
blocks.text: When a noun is modified by a quantity, a measure word must follow the numeral: Number + Measure + Noun.
blocks.ex:
一杯咖啡
one cup of coffee
十支手機
ten cell phones
三個弟弟
three younger brothers

blocks.label: Structures 2
blocks.text: A determiner 這、那、哪 appears first. When followed by a quantity, 一 is usually omitted.
blocks.ex:
這兩杯熱咖啡一共多少錢？
How much are these two cups of coffee?
那三支手機太舊了。
Those three phones are too old.
哪種手機不貴？
Which kind is not expensive?

gps.title: II. Preposition 幫 bāng on behalf of

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Beneficiary 幫

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 幫 bāng introduces the beneficiary of an action and means doing something for someone.
blocks.ex:
請幫我微波包子。
Please microwave the baozi for me.
請幫我照相。
Please take a picture for me.
請幫我買一杯咖啡。
Please buy a coffee for me.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: 不 must appear before 幫, never before the main verb: Subject + 不 + 幫 + Beneficiary + VP.
blocks.ex:
他不幫我微波包子。
He will not microwave the baozi for me.
姐姐不幫弟弟買咖啡。
Sister will not buy coffee for brother.

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: 幫 can be used in A-not-A, 嗎, and question-word questions.
blocks.ex:
你幫不幫他買手機？
Will you buy a phone for him?
他幫你照相嗎？
Did he take a photo for you?

gps.title: III. 的 De-phrase with Head Noun Omitted

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Head Noun Omission

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: If the head noun is clear from context, it is commonly omitted, leaving Modifier + 的.
blocks.ex:
A：你要買新手機還是舊手機？
Do you want a new or old phone?
B：我要新的，不要舊的。
I want a new one, not an old one.

blocks.label: Negation & Questions
blocks.text: The de-phrase can appear in negative statements and questions.
blocks.ex:
你的手機不是新的。
Your phone is not new.
這杯咖啡不熱，我要熱的。
This coffee is not hot; I want a hot one.
手機，他買不買舊的？
Will he buy an old phone?

gps.title: IV. 太 tài…了 le overly

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Excessive Degree

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 太 + Vs + 了 indicates that a state exceeds the normal range and often conveys the speaker’s subjective dissatisfaction.
blocks.ex:
太貴了！
Too expensive!
太大了！
Too big!
太熱了！
Too hot!

blocks.label: 用法
blocks.text: 太 + Vs can serve as a predicate by itself. Adding 了 gives the expression stronger subjective emotion.

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Capability 能

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: The auxiliary verb 能 expresses a function or ability possessed by the subject.
blocks.ex:
新手機能上網。
New cell phones can go online.
那支手機能照相。
That phone can take photos.

blocks.label: 否定
blocks.text: 不 always appears before 能.
blocks.ex:
我的手機不能上網。
My phone cannot access the internet.
誰的手機不能照相？
Whose phone cannot take pictures?

blocks.label: 疑問
blocks.text: Questions commonly use 能不能.
blocks.ex:
你的手機能不能照相？
Can your phone take pictures?
舊的能不能上網？
Can the old one go online?

blocks.label: 小節
blocks.text: Approximate Numbers with 多

blocks.label: 功能
blocks.text: 多 after a number means more than or over that number.

blocks.label: Structures 1
blocks.text: After numbers of ten or above: rounded number + 多 + measure + noun.
blocks.ex:
二十多個人
over 20 people
一千多支手機
over 1,000 phones
三萬四千多塊錢
over 34,000 dollars

blocks.label: Structures 2
blocks.text: After a one-digit amount or decimal amount, 多 follows the measure word.
blocks.ex:
五塊多錢
more than 5 dollars
一塊多錢
more than 1 dollar

qs.prompt: 你為什麼不買那種手機？

qs.prompt: 你們為什麼不賣小杯咖啡？
